2760: The thief left long before you did. You have patience, which is just stubbornness that learned to sit still.
2761: Put the tired in a pocket for now. You can take it out later, once there is nothing left to do.
2762: Every good chase begins with one unglamorous step onto an ordinary floor. This is that step.
2763: You're on the clock. Not a frightening clock. A patient one. But moving. Best to move with it.
2764: Point yourself at a street and go. Certainty is a thing you assemble later, out of spare parts.
2765: The city is not going to introduce itself. You'll have to walk over and start the conversation.
